title: Data for: open reconstruction and pre-registered recalibration of a fuzzy-logic fracture-healing model
description: Simulation output data, in vivo and digitized reference data, and the rule base in machine-readable form supporting the associated article: reconstruction of the Simon et al. (2011) / Steiner et al. (2013) fuzzy-logic fracture-healing model, numerical verification, pre-registered recalibration with leave-one-out cross-validation, structural screens and a registered latency extension. The protocol and every dated amendment are included. Frozen files carry SHA-256 hashes.
